lagna_themes.0: With Aries (Mesha) rising as your Ascendant, you carry a courageous, pioneering spirit that thrives when initiating bold ventures with clarity.

lagna_themes.9: With Capricorn (Makara) rising as your Ascendant, quiet perseverance and pragmatic mastery allow you to construct enduring achievements step by step.
lagna_themes.10: With Aquarius (Kumbha) rising as your Ascendant, progressive vision and humanitarian insight orient your journey toward forward-thinking contribution.
lagna_themes.11: With Pisces (Meena) rising as your Ascendant, compassionate imagination and spiritual grace lend subtle harmony to everything you touch.
